notes: Fixes the new FEFC app for phones and tablets (FEFC.apk) crashing on launch. Its app ID is now com.fefc.kodi, so reinstall it from the link. The Fire TV app is unchanged.

The new FEFC app for phones and tablets (FEFC.apk) now includes 64-bit Kodi, so it installs on 64-bit-only devices such as the Pixel Fold and Pixel Tablet. It also still runs on 32-bit devices. The Fire TV app is unchanged.
New installs can use a separate FEFC app (com.faneditfanclub.fefc.kodi) that installs alongside regular Kodi from the Play Store.
Existing FEFC installs keep updating as before, and each one downloads the update that matches it.
Fire Stick home: the FEFC app tile now uses a plain FEFC icon like the original FEFC Fire TV app, instead of the adaptive icon that Fire Sticks showed as a grey grid.

Updates: after What's New, pressing Install closes every popup and downloads in one go with a progress bar. No other update popup can open on top, a dropped connection resumes and retries by itself, and the file is checked before Android's installer opens.

Fire TV home: the FEFC banner tile now uses the same banner setup as the original FEFC Fire TV app (320x180 banner in the default and xhdpi folders), so older Fire Sticks show FEFC art instead of a grey placeholder.
The FEFC icon and banner on the Fire TV home and apps row are fixed: each update now has its own Android version number, so Fire TV refreshes the app tile instead of showing it blank.
Home tile counts now match the web app: Main Collection no longer double-counts files from shortcuts and To Be Catalogued, and Fan Edit Collections now counts its shortcut collections.
The FEFC app icon is back next to the version and update button on the Home screen.
Home tiles show counts like the web app: collections and files on Main Collection, Fan Edit Collections and To Be Catalogued; collections on Actors & Directors; genres on Genres.
The My List tile has a star and shows how many items you've starred. Counts update every minute.
My List: the sync popup only opens when you select Link My List or Sync, and it no longer pops up again after you close it and go back Home.
When My List isn't linked, its first item reads Link My List.
The update popup now waits until the Home screen is showing after the intro.

The top bar (version, Search, Settings, About, clock) and the community news ticker with its icons now show on every page: home, lists, details, Read Me and settings. Press Up to reach the bar. Both hide while a video plays full screen.
Link My List: the QR code now loads from the web on a white background, and the full link shows underneath so you can type it on your phone if you need to.

Link My List: the QR code is now a standard full-colour image on a white background, so it shows on Fire TV instead of a black square. If it can't be made on the device, it loads from the web instead.
News ticker: each post now has its Discord, Facebook, X or Reddit icon right before it as it scrolls, like the web app. The grouped icons by COMMUNITY are gone.
Link My List: the QR code now shows (it was a blank square on Fire TV).
Link My List: the link address is shortened so it fits on screen.
The community news ticker shows the Discord, Facebook, X and Reddit icons, like the web app ticker.

Home screen is back to the 3x3 grid in the same order as the web app: Read Me, New Arrivals, Support Us / Fan Edit Collections, Main Collection, To Be Catalogued / Actors & Directors, My List, Genres.
Search, Settings and About moved to a top bar, like the web app header.
Read Me: link addresses are no longer spelled out, and the file count now says 6,000.
Selecting a movie or episode now opens its details page first; Play is a button there.
Search: pressing Enter opens the results directly and the keyboard no longer pops up over them.
My List sync entry is now a proper menu action.
The intro now plays first, with no flash of the menu.
New home screen: Read Me, New Arrivals, Support Us, My List, Collections, Main Collection, To Be Catalogued, Genres, Actors & Directors, Search, Settings and About.
Main Collection opens the top level of the whole collection, like the web app.
Continue Watching and Recently Opened, synced with your My List and the web app.
Sort any collection (A-Z, Z-A, Recently Added, Most Files) and Shuffle Play a collection or genre.
My List sorting, plus ratings and file size on the details page.
Landscape tiles for collections, poster tiles for edits, safe-area margins and a scrolling community news ticker.
Back while a video plays pauses it and keeps your place; RESUME or STOP from the menu.
Open in VLC and Open in Drive from the details page; FEFC navigation sounds.
The update screen shows this what's-new list; the home Update tile always shows your version and flags a new one. A check runs after the intro.
